contract: A retry of a sequence still in the duplicate window returns the original base offset and does not advance the log.
A gap is OUT_OF_ORDER_SEQUENCE_NUMBER and writes nothing.
An older epoch is INVALID_PRODUCER_EPOCH and writes nothing. Epoch i16::MAX cannot be bumped.
Reopen still answers the lost acknowledgement with the original offset.
limits: This is not the InitProducerId or Produce RPC.
The duplicate window is five batches. Transactional producer state stays on KL11-24.
The journal format is the local PLIDEM01 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
